subtitle: One
description: Only the index finger points up. The other fingers and the thumb are folded into a fist.
steps: Make a fist.
Raise only your index finger straight up.
Keep the other fingers and the thumb folded.

subtitle: Two
description: Index and middle fingers up in a V shape.
steps: Make a fist.
Raise the index and middle fingers and spread them a little.
Hold the ring finger, pinky and thumb folded.

subtitle: Three
description: Thumb, index and middle fingers are out. Ring finger and pinky are folded.
steps: Fold the ring finger and pinky into the palm.
Raise the index and middle fingers.
Stick the thumb out to the side.

subtitle: Four
description: Four fingers up, thumb folded across the palm.
steps: Open your hand.
Raise index, middle, ring and pinky.
Fold the thumb across the palm.

subtitle: Five
description: Open palm, all five fingers spread.
steps: Open your hand with the palm to the camera.
Spread all five fingers.

subtitle: Six
description: Index, middle and ring fingers up. The thumb touches the pinky.
steps: Raise the index, middle and ring fingers.
Bend the pinky down.
Touch the tip of the thumb to the tip of the pinky.

subtitle: Seven
description: Index, middle and pinky up. The thumb touches the ring finger.
steps: Raise the index, middle and pinky.
Bend the ring finger down.
Touch the thumb to the ring finger.

subtitle: Eight
description: Index, ring and pinky up. The thumb touches the middle finger.
steps: Raise the index, ring and pinky.
Bend the middle finger down.
Touch the thumb to the middle finger.

subtitle: Nine
description: Middle, ring and pinky up. The thumb touches the index finger.
steps: Raise the middle, ring and pinky.
Bend the index finger down.
Touch the thumb to the index finger.

subtitle: Ten
description: A fist with the thumb pointing up.
steps: Make a fist.
Point the thumb straight up.

title: A
subtitle: Letter
description: Fist with the thumb resting against the side of the index finger.
steps: Make a fist.
Rest the thumb against the side of the index finger, pointing up.

title: B
subtitle: Letter
description: Four fingers straight up and together, thumb folded across the palm.
steps: Hold four fingers straight up, pressed together.
Fold the thumb across the palm.

title: C
subtitle: Letter
description: Curve your whole hand into the shape of the letter C.
steps: Curve all fingers together.
Curve the thumb to match, so the hand makes a C.

title: D
subtitle: Letter
description: Index finger up. The other fingers curl and touch the thumb, making a small circle.
steps: Point the index finger up.
Curl the other three fingers down to touch the thumb tip.
The thumb and fingers make a small circle.

title: E
subtitle: Letter
description: Fingers bent down so the tips touch the thumb, which is tucked underneath.
steps: Bend all four fingers down.
Tuck the thumb under the fingertips.

title: F
subtitle: Letter
description: Thumb and index finger touch to make a circle. The other three fingers point up.
steps: Touch the tips of the thumb and index finger to make a circle.
Raise the other three fingers straight up.

title: G
subtitle: Letter
description: Index finger and thumb point sideways, parallel to each other. Other fingers closed.
steps: Turn the hand sideways.
Point the index finger forward with the thumb parallel to it.
Close the other fingers.

title: H
subtitle: Letter
description: Index and middle fingers point sideways together. Other fingers closed.
steps: Turn the hand sideways.
Point the index and middle fingers forward, together.
Close the other fingers and the thumb.

title: I
subtitle: Letter
description: Fist with the pinky pointing up.
steps: Make a fist.
Raise only the pinky.

title: J
subtitle: Letter
description: Pinky up like the letter I, then draw a J in the air.
steps: Make the I handshape: fist with the pinky up.
Draw a J in the air: down, then curve to the left.

title: K
subtitle: Letter
description: Index and middle fingers up in a V. The thumb touches the base of the middle finger.
steps: Raise the index and middle fingers in a V.
Place the thumb on the base of the middle finger.
Fold the ring finger and pinky.

title: L
subtitle: Letter
description: Thumb and index finger make an L shape. Other fingers closed.
steps: Point the index finger up.
Stick the thumb out to the side, making an L.
Fold the other three fingers.

title: M
subtitle: Letter
description: Fist with the thumb tucked under the index, middle and ring fingers.
steps: Make a fist.
Tuck the thumb under the index, middle and ring fingers.

title: N
subtitle: Letter
description: Fist with the thumb tucked under the index and middle fingers.
steps: Make a fist.
Tuck the thumb under the index and middle fingers.

title: O
subtitle: Letter
description: All fingers curve and touch the thumb, making the shape of the letter O.
steps: Curve all fingers.
Touch the fingertips to the thumb tip, making an O.

title: P
subtitle: Letter
description: Like K, but the hand points down.
steps: Make the K handshape (V with the thumb on the middle finger).
Turn the hand so the fingers point down.

title: Q
subtitle: Letter
description: Like G, but the hand points down.
steps: Make the G handshape (index and thumb parallel).
Turn the hand so they point down.

title: R
subtitle: Letter
description: Index and middle fingers up and crossed.
steps: Raise the index and middle fingers.
Cross the middle finger over the index finger.
Fold the other fingers.

title: S
subtitle: Letter
description: Fist with the thumb across the front of the fingers.
steps: Make a fist.
Place the thumb across the front of the fingers.

title: T
subtitle: Letter
description: Fist with the thumb tucked between the index and middle fingers.
steps: Make a fist.
Tuck the thumb between the index and middle fingers.

title: U
subtitle: Letter
description: Index and middle fingers up and held together.
steps: Raise the index and middle fingers, pressed together.
Hold the thumb over the ring finger and pinky.

title: V
subtitle: Letter
description: Index and middle fingers up and spread apart (a V).
steps: Raise the index and middle fingers and spread them (a V).
Hold the thumb over the ring finger and pinky.

title: W
subtitle: Letter
description: Index, middle and ring fingers up and spread. Thumb holds the pinky.
steps: Raise the index, middle and ring fingers and spread them.
Hold the pinky down with the thumb.

title: X
subtitle: Letter
description: Index finger bent like a hook. Other fingers closed.
steps: Make a fist.
Bend the index finger like a hook.

title: Y
subtitle: Letter
description: Thumb and pinky stick out. The other fingers are closed.
steps: Stick out the thumb and the pinky.
Fold the other three fingers.

title: Z
subtitle: Letter
description: Draw the letter Z in the air with your index finger.
steps: Point the index finger.
Draw a Z in the air: right, diagonal down-left, right again.
